dashboard.label: ITSI Maintenance Window Management - Set up
dashboard.description: Configure the itsimaintenance command's safety controls (stored in itsi_maintenance.conf [safety]). Works in Splunk Web, including Splunk Cloud.

div.p: These are safety controls for the itsimaintenance command. They are not security boundaries by themselves — ITSI's own capabilities and object RBAC always apply. Keep dry-run on until validated.
div.label: Dry run by default (validate only, no writes)
Enable delete (destructive; off by default). This is the single switch — no need to also edit allowed operations.
Allow cancelling an already-active window
Require a change_id on write operations
Auto-split mixed entity+service requests into separate windows
div.p: Note: the alert action has its own parameters, editable in the alert configuration UI when you add the action to a saved search.
